name: Emergency Benefit
description: A last-resort financial assistance benefit for clients in hardship who cannot qualify for another benefit, with comprehensive eligibility, obligations, payment, and review provisions.

attributes.summary: A last-resort financial assistance benefit for clients in hardship who cannot qualify for another benefit, with comprehensive eligibility, obligations, payment, and review provisions.
attributes.eligibility: Client in hardship, unable to earn a sufficient livelihood, not eligible for another benefit, ordinarily resident in New Zealand. Covers domestic situations, caring responsibilities, health conditions, immigration status, and age-based circumstances.
attributes.payment_details: Income tested with asset test applied. Subject to income abatement thresholds and cut-out points. Includes youth money management provisions and mandatory review requirements.
attributes.obligations: Work obligations, work preparation obligations, social obligations, drug test obligations, and youth activity obligations. Youth money management requirements apply to eligible young people.
attributes.stand_down: Initial stand-down provisions apply. Stand-down periods apply in specific circumstances as defined in the Social Security Act 2018.
attributes.income_test: Income test applies with specified abatement thresholds and cut-out points.
